races.paceDynamic: Nakamura is the most likely pace-setter with prominent early tendencies, though Breaking Dawn and several other prominent runners could press forward creating a competitive early gallop. The large field of 13 runners with multiple prominent types suggests a solid but not frantic early pace, with the tempo likely quickening from the 2f pole as the field compresses. The pace should be honest enough to set up the race for those with tactical speed who can position handily. This race shape favours prominent runners and those with the pace to track the leaders closely rather than pure hold-up horses who may find too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royale
scenarios.trigger: If Nakamura, Breaking Dawn and Stone Bear all go forward together creating competitive fractions
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes solid with multiple speed horses engaged, setting up a battle between the handy horses with tactical speed. Those able to sit just off the pace in prime striking positions will have the edge over pure front-runners and back-markers alike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Nakamura Leads Unopposed
scenarios.trigger: If Nakamura gets an uncontested lead with other prominent runners settling behind
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sedate allowing Nakamura to dictate terms and potentially steal a march on the field. Front-runners and prominent racers who travel easily get first run on anything coming from behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong with prominent runners going too fast too early
scenarios.body: The speed horses tire in the closing stages opening the door for patient hold-up types to come with strong late runs. The pace collapse favours those with finishing kicks who can pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If unexpected pace emerges from Venetian Star or Dancing Saxon joining the early battle
scenarios.body: Multiple horses commit to racing prominently early creating faster fractions than anticipated, compromising the chances of the expected pace-setters. This chaotic pace dynamic could allow a mid-division runner to emerge.

watchPoints.text: Nakamura could get too easy a lead if other prominent runners don't engage early enough, making him very hard to peg back

races.paceDynamic: I'm Spartacus leads a small prominent group including Rosato, Hero Of The Hour, Step Back In Time, Jampa Ling and El Fontenaro, but no confirmed strong pace-setter creates significant early tempo. The large field of 16 runners contains multiple hold-up horses (The Love Machine, Sayonara, Dervo Annie, Whatswrongnow, Spiced Gold, Son Of Wind, Another Nice'day, Mini Cotai) who will be tracking from off the pace. With softer ground conditions and a moderate early gallop likely, this creates a tactical affair where horses need to be positioned handy turning for home. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid getting caught in traffic late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Handy
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Spartacus sets a steady tempo without serious pressure early
scenarios.body: The prominent group gets first run on the field and holds off late challengers on the testing ground. Horses positioned handy can kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finish From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses into a crawl through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where hold-up horses with Colin Keane and Shane Foley get superior position. Fresh legs from the back prove decisive in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running early and jockeys play cat-and-mouse
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start which creates a messy tactical affair with multiple moves. Experienced riders and horses who can quicken from any position hold the key.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Front Runner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses goes forward unexpectedly to force the tempo
scenarios.body: Rosato or El Fontenaro decide to press I'm Spartacus and create a genuine gallop that suits closers. The early leaders fold and backmarkers with tactical speed benefit.

races.paceDynamic: Alnofoor is the only confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner handicap and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure from early rivals. With 16 hold-up horses behind him, this creates a classic scenario where the pace-setter controls the race tempo throughout the 6 furlongs. The large field of hold-up runners will bunch up in behind, creating traffic problems and positioning battles in the straight. This race shape strongly favours either the lone pace-setter Alnofoor or any hold-up horse that can secure a clear passage and time their challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Alnofoor maintains his lead unchallenged and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the soft ground.
scenarios.body: The veteran gets first run on his rivals and stays on strongly as the closers struggle to make up ground in time. His recent wins at similar distances and going give him the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pace allows strong finishers to close from the back and traffic clears in the straight.
scenarios.body: Prime Sign and Verhoyen benefit from their proven finishing kicks, with Prime Sign's recent win and Verhoyen's consistent placing record making them the primary threats. The soft ground aids their sustained gallops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Youth Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the younger horses' stamina tells in the final furlong as older rivals tire on testing ground.
scenarios.body: Hooves Your Daddy and One Cool Bear, both three-year-olds with recent good form, outstay their elders in a driving finish. Their lighter weights and upward curves make them dangerous.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems eliminate the fancied runners and an unconsidered horse gets a clean run through.
scenarios.body: The large field creates chaos in the straight, allowing a horse like Jackandthefox or Glen Breeze to sneak through on the inside rail. Their lower ratings become irrelevant if the race falls apart.

watchPoints.text: Monitor Alnofoor's early fractions - if he goes too fast early he'll be vulnerable to late closers

The three-year-olds carry significant weight advantages which could prove decisive in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Zodiac Bear will likely lead with Love Billy Boy and the prominent brigade (Moss Tucker, Frescobaldi, Ocean's Breath, Queen Of The Bogs) tracking close behind, creating a moderate early gallop over 7 furlongs. The lack of multiple confirmed front-runners means Zodiac Bear can dictate terms without excessive pressure, though the cluster of prominent runners will keep him honest. With three hold-up horses (Tina's Indian, Cowardofthecounty, Tolebi) relying on late runs, the pace scenario should develop into a sustained drive from the 2-furlong pole. This tactical setup favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the front-running pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Zodiac Bear sets manageable fractions and the prominent pack stays in touch
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical battle from 2f out where horses like Ocean's Breath and Frescobaldi can time their challenges perfectly. Hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close the gap effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard trying to track Zodiac Bear early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable for the front group, allowing Tina's Indian and Cowardofthecounty to unleash devastating late runs. The experienced Gavin Ryan and Declan McDonogh can exploit the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Zodiac Bear gets uncontested early fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Ben Coen can steal crucial lengths turning for home while the prominent pack hesitates and hold-up horses face an impossible task. Recent winner Ocean's Breath provides the main threat but may lack the tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage Zodiac Bear too early creating a stop-start rhythm
scenarios.body: The race fragments with no clear pace advantage, turning into a messy sprint where class and current form become decisive. Queen Of The Bogs returning from a long break could surprise at big odds.

races.paceDynamic: Voice Of Reason is the only confirmed front runner in this field of 21, meaning he can dictate terms from the front without pressure. The prominent runners like Not Just Any Eagle, Just Keep Flying, Slurricane, and Boxing Great will likely sit just behind in the second rank, but won't challenge Voice Of Reason early over this staying trip. With a large field spreading out behind and many hold-up horses including Alba Chiara, Dutch Gold, and Night Moon needing to weave through traffic, the lack of early pace pressure creates a tactical setup. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the lone leader and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks who can navigate the large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Voice Of Reason gets an easy lead and maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: Voice Of Reason controls the gallop throughout and has enough left to repel challers, while prominent trackers benefit from the strong pace. The large field gets strung out behind the moderate tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows closers to unleash devastating finishes
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure means hold-up horses can time their runs perfectly through the big field as the pace quickens late. Alba Chiara and Night Moon can pick their way through with superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent runner perfectly judges the moment to challenge Voice Of Reason
scenarios.body: Just Keep Flying or Boxing Great sit ideally placed to strike turning for home when Voice Of Reason's stamina wanes. The tactical position proves decisive as they avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Voice Of Reason stops suddenly and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The front runner's stamina gives out dramatically, turning the race into a cavalry charge where any horse with a turn of foot can win. Traffic problems intensify as the field bunches up.

races.paceDynamic: Tassarolo stands alone as the only confirmed pace-setter among 21 runners, giving him uncontested control from the front. With Chopsticks the only other prominent runner, the early pace will be moderate and sustainable, allowing Tassarolo to dictate terms without pressure. The massive field of 19 hold-up horses will create a wall of traffic problems turning for home, with positioning becoming critical on the long Fairyhouse straight. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic chaos behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tassarolo Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Tassarolo gets an uncontested lead and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter exploits his tactical advantage while the cavalry charge gets bottled up behind, with Shane Foley timing the finish perfectly from the front. Hold-up horses struggle to find clear runs in the crowded stretch as Tassarolo holds on gamely.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Chopsticks tracks Tassarolo perfectly and times his challenge
scenarios.body: The Patrick McGettigan-ridden runner sits in the ideal stalking position before swooping past a tiring Tassarolo in the final furlong. Early positioning proves decisive as the majority of the field encounters traffic problems when making their moves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find clear passage and the pace collapses
scenarios.body: A strong finisher like God Of Thunder or Alto Sax navigates through the field to catch the front-runners who went too fast early. The large field spreads out enough to provide racing room for the talented closers to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Tassarolo and Chopsticks fade dramatically in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the back as multiple hold-up horses surge simultaneously in a blanket finish. Positioning luck and jockey skill become paramount as horses weave through traffic in a chaotic finale.
